faq.a: Download the trial version to test all features before purchasing.

apps.name: KataCopy
apps.description: Stop waiting on slow file transfers. KataCopy is a high-performance desktop utility built from the ground up for power users who need to move files across drives and networks at maximum speed.
features: Adaptive performance based on system resources

faq.q: How much faster is KataCopy than Windows copy?
faq.a: Transfer speeds depend on your hardware, but KataCopy optimizes every layer—disk I/O, RAM buffers, and parallel threads—to maximize throughput.

faq.q: Does it work with network drives?
faq.a: Yes, KataCopy handles local drives, external drives, and network shares.

faq.q: Can I pause and resume transfers?
faq.a: Yes, pause and resume any transfer without losing progress.
